title: Encyclopedia Galactica alien taxonomy sent to the congressman

tellings.quote: somebody sent me both volumes of the Encyclopedia Galactica

plain: The congressman Eric Burlison says someone sent him both volumes of the Encyclopedia Galactica, a document laying out a classification of alien types. He tells it as something that happened to him, without saying who sent it, and if genuine it would mean someone wanted a member of Congress to have a catalogue of non-human beings.
